headline: Study Shows Gulf of Mexico Marine Life Has Not Recovered From 2010 BP Oil Spill
summary: A new study reveals that marine populations in the Gulf of Mexico dropped about 60% following the 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill and remain below pre-spill levels.
why: BP plc is a global oil and gas major that faced tens of billions of dollars in liabilities following the 2010 Deepwater Horizon explosion.
